rationale: IFC disclosure portal is a standing, searchable register of bank-level Ukrainian transactions with pre-approval SII publication.
EBRD PSD search is the canonical filterable register of EBRD financial-institution projects in Ukraine.
EBRD newsroom is a continuously producing feed naming Ukrainian bank counterparties and volumes.
IMF Ukraine country page yields recurring staff reports with systematic banking soundness data; failed verification is soft only.
IMF eLibrary is a standalone structured database giving parse-friendly versions of the same Ukraine reports.
Single dated MEFP PDF on bank.gov.ua — valuable local-language evidence, not a recurring feed.
MoF per-IFI portfolio pages are an authoritative Ukrainian-side roster but URL check failed; re-verify liveness.
World Bank projects portal is a queryable operation register covering Ukraine financial-sector DPLs.
Documents & Reports is a standalone full-text archive of WB Ukraine banking and payments analytics.
Static brief page under worldbank.org already covered by the projects/documents parents; useful context only.
MIGA Ukraine response hub keeps issuing guarantee briefs naming banks, amounts and covered risks; no sibling coverage.
EIB press/project register continuously discloses EU4Business guarantee deals with named Ukrainian banks.
DFC press release feed carries statutorily pre-disclosed Ukrainian financial-sector commitments.
Early Warning System is a live aggregator preserving revised/retired IFI disclosures in uniform structure.
Donor Coordination Platform publishes recurring compendia mapping IFI/DFI instruments available to Ukrainian banks.
OpenAid register is a lead-mining crosswalk of project names; reachability unknown (http, failed check).
MDA fund page is an ebrd.com section covered by PSD and news monitoring; annual reports still useful evidence.
Standalone programme site listing participating Ukrainian partner banks and Ukrainian-language terms; distinct domain.
IFC Ukraine country page is a section of ifc.org already monitored via the disclosure portal.
Deep sub-page of Ukreximbank's site; monitor the bank's IR/disclosure parent rather than this one page.
kmu.gov.ua homepage is a broad government press feed with low signal density for banking/payments; revisit with filtered path.
